notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Psychosis Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent.
Resolve the first Bloodthirsty Conqueror trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
